language.name: English
ribbon.title: Peer Vault Sync
notice.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
notice.configChanged: Settings were updated by sync ({count} files). Restart Obsidian to apply them.
notice.notConfigured: Peer Vault Sync is not set up yet. Open Settings → Peer Vault Sync to set the relay server and pair this device.
notice.notRunning: Sync is not running. Finish setup in Settings → Peer Vault Sync.
notice.vaultCreated: New vault key created. Show the setup code to add other devices.
notice.conflict.merged: edits from both sides were merged
notice.conflict.keptSelf: kept the version from this device
notice.conflict.history: The other version is kept in the file history (View file history).
status.title: Sync status
status.relay.unconfigured.hint: Set the relay server and pair this device in Settings → Peer Vault Sync.
status.relay.offline.hint: The relay server cannot be reached. Changes are kept and sync when the connection is back.
status.relay.pending.hint: Ask the relay administrator to open the server dashboard, go to Peers, check that the fingerprint below matches this device, and approve it.
status.relay.revoked.hint: The relay administrator revoked this device. Ask them to approve it again.
status.relay.unauthorized.hint: The relay could not verify this device. Check that the device clock is correct.
status.relay.room_full.hint: This vault has reached the relay's device limit. Ask the administrator to remove a device or raise the limit.
status.relay.too_many_pending.hint: Too many devices are waiting for approval on this relay. Ask the administrator to review them.
status.relay.quota.hint: The relay's storage for this vault is full. Changes still sync directly between online devices.
status.relay.http.hint: The relay returned an unexpected response. Check the relay server address.
status.webrtc.unavailable: Not available on this device. Syncing through the relay mailbox only.
error.event: Could not record a file change: {message}
error.scan: Could not scan the vault, will retry: {message}
error.prune: Could not clean up old history: {message}
error.badBundle: A mailbox bundle could not be read and was skipped ({id}).
error.tooLargeForMailbox: {path} is too large for the mailbox; it syncs only when both devices are online.
setup.error.format: This is not a Peer Vault Sync setup code.
setup.error.relay: The setup code has an invalid relay address. Only https:// is allowed (http:// only for localhost).
setup.error.key: The setup code has an invalid vault key.
setup.warning: Anyone who gets this code can read your vault. Share it only with your own devices.
setup.show.title: Add another device
setup.show.scan: Scan the QR code with the other device's camera, or copy the code and paste it under "Join an existing vault" on that device.
setup.alreadyPaired: This device is already paired with that vault.
setup.confirm.title: Join vault?
setup.confirm.relay: This device will connect to the relay server {relay}.
setup.confirm.vault: Files will be synced into this vault: {vault}.
setup.confirm.replaceKey: This device is paired with another vault. It will leave that vault and stop syncing with its devices.
setup.confirm.merge: This vault already has {count} files. They will be merged with the remote vault. When a file exists on both sides with different content, notes are merged where possible and otherwise the newest version is kept; the replaced content can be restored from the file history.
setup.joined: Joined. The relay administrator may need to approve this device.
settings.relay.heading: Relay server
settings.relay.name: Relay server address
settings.relay.desc: The address of your relay server. It forwards encrypted data and cannot read your notes.
settings.relay.invalid: Enter an https:// address (http:// is allowed only for localhost).
settings.relay.test.fail: Could not reach the relay server.
settings.pair.heading: Pairing
settings.pair.key.set: Set (hidden). It gives full access to this vault.
settings.pair.key.unset: Not set. Create a new vault or join an existing one.
settings.pair.first.name: This is the first device
settings.pair.first.desc: Create a new vault key. Then add your other devices with the setup code.
settings.pair.join.name: Join an existing vault
settings.pair.join.desc: Paste the setup code shown on a device that is already paired.
settings.pair.join.descReplace: Paste the setup code of another vault. This device will leave its current vault.
settings.pair.share.name: Add another device
settings.pair.share.desc: Show the setup code and QR code for another device. Anyone with the code can read your vault.
settings.pair.share.needRelay: Set a valid relay server address first.
settings.pair.rekey.name: Replace vault key
settings.pair.rekey.desc: Creates a new key. Every other device stops syncing until it is paired again.
settings.pair.rekey.confirm.title: Replace the vault key?
settings.pair.rekey.confirm.body1: This device will move to a new vault on the relay. Your other devices keep the old key and stop syncing with this device.
settings.pair.rekey.confirm.body2: To continue syncing, pair every other device again with the new setup code. Files are not deleted.
settings.device.heading: This device
settings.status.name: Status
settings.history.heading: File history
settings.history.days.desc: Older versions are removed after this many days. The current version of each file is always kept.
settings.history.days.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings.ignore.heading: Ignore rules
settings.ignore.name: Files kept out of sync
settings.ignore.desc: One gitignore-style pattern per line. Saved as .syncignore at the vault root and synced to every device. Matching files stop syncing; copies already on other devices are kept.
settings.ignore.failed: Could not read or save the ignore rules: {message}
settings.language.heading: Language
settings.language.name: Interface language
settings.language.desc: Languages added on the relay server are listed too. Command names change after Obsidian restarts.
settings.language.refresh.fail: Could not load languages from the relay server.
history.title: History: {path}
history.empty: No history for this file yet.
history.detail.deleted: The file was deleted in this version. Pick an earlier version to restore.
history.detail.expired: The content of this version is no longer kept (older than the history period, or not received yet). It cannot be restored.
history.restore.title: Restore this version?
history.restore.body: {path} will be replaced with the version from {time}. The current content stays in the history.
history.diff.gone: The file does not exist now. Restoring recreates it.
history.diff.legend: − only in this version   + only in the current file
deleted.placeholder: Pick a deleted file to see its history
